name: run_tests
description: Detect the repository's test framework (unittest, pytest-style, node:test), run the tests correctly in this sandbox (python3 3.9 without pytest; node --test), and return structured results: framework, rerunnable command, exit_code, passed/failed counts and a failing list of {id, file, line, message}. Run it from the repository root instead of probing for python/pytest by hand. Test ids: unittest and pytest classes -> Class.test_method; pytest functions -> module_stem.test_name; node:test -> the test's name.

path.description: Subdirectory (or single test file) to test, relative to the repository root.

filter.description: Only run tests whose id contains this substring (e.g. 'CalcTest', 'test_reverse', 'clamp'). For node:test it is passed as --test-name-pattern.

timeout.description: Seconds before the run is stopped; the unfinished test is reported as failing.
